construct_bond_matrix: construct a bond adjacency matrix for a pymatgen crystal structure using a near neighbor finder
construct_bond_matrix_with_permutations: construct a bond matrix with custom site permutations for reordered atom indices in a crystal structure
analyze_crystal_bonds: analyze covalent bonds between atoms in a pymatgen Structure and return a binary adjacency matrix
build_adjacency_from_neighbors: build a square adjacency matrix where entries indicate bonds between atoms using pymatgen near neighbor info
review_construct_bond_matrix: review the construct_bond_matrix function that creates an adjacency matrix from pymatgen near neighbor analysis
